Downstream analysis of the pySCENIC run in `02_run_pyscenic_genie3.sh`
(GENIE3 -> cisTarget -> AUCell on the Callari cohort, 37 MBC vs 53 FBC).

Same statistical framework as the rest of the manuscript: two-sided Wilcoxon
rank-sum test per regulon, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR, significance at FDR < 0.05.

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(data.table); library(ggplot2); library(ggrepel)

auc_dir <- "Output_genie3"
#mod_gmt <- "~/Desktop/MBC/06_Network_analysis/Raw_Data/callari_knn25_coexpr_mods_corrected.gmt"
out_dir <- "Output_analysis"; dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## 1. Load AUCell scores and sample annotation

```{r load}
read_auc <- function(f) {
  a <- fread(f)
  m <- as.matrix(a[, -1]); rownames(m) <- a[[1]]      # samples x regulons
  m <- t(m)                                           # -> regulons x samples
  rownames(m) <- sub("\\(\\+\\)$", "", rownames(m))   # "IRF8(+)" -> "IRF8"
  m
}
auc  <- read_auc(file.path(auc_dir, "auc_genie3.csv"))
meta <- fread("Input/callari_meta.csv")
meta <- meta[match(colnames(auc), sample)]
stopifnot(identical(meta$sample, colnames(auc)))

male   <- meta[sex == "male",   sample]
female <- meta[sex == "female", sample]
cat(nrow(auc), "regulons |", length(male), "MBC |", length(female), "FBC\n")
```

## 2. Regulon sizes

```{r regulons}
reg <- fread(file.path(auc_dir, "regulons_genie3.csv"), skip = 3, header = FALSE)
## column 1 = TF, column 9 = target list "[('GENE', weight), ...]"
setnames(reg, c(1, 9), c("TF", "targets"))
reg[, TF := sub("\\(\\+\\)$", "", TF)]
parse_targets <- function(x) unique(regmatches(x, gregexpr("(?<=\\(')[^']+", x, perl = TRUE))[[1]])
reg_list <- setNames(lapply(reg$targets, parse_targets), reg$TF)
reg_list <- reg_list[rownames(auc)]
data.table(regulon = names(reg_list), n_targets = lengths(reg_list))[order(-n_targets)][1:10]
```

## 3. Differential regulon activity (Wilcoxon, FDR < 0.05)

```{r de}
wilcox_regulons <- function(mat, g1, g2, name1 = "MBC", name2 = "FBC") {
  m1 <- mat[, g1, drop = FALSE]; m2 <- mat[, g2, drop = FALSE]
  p <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(mat)), function(i)
    suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(m1[i, ], m2[i, ])$p.value), numeric(1))
  med1 <- matrixStats::rowMedians(m1); med2 <- matrixStats::rowMedians(m2)
  res <- data.table(regulon = rownames(mat), med1, med2,
                    median_difference = med1 - med2, pvalue = p,
                    FDR = p.adjust(p, "BH"))
  setnames(res, c("med1", "med2"), paste0(c(name1, name2), "_median"))
  res[, signed_logP := -log10(pvalue) * ifelse(median_difference > 0, 1, -1)]
  res[order(-signed_logP)]
}

de <- wilcox_regulons(auc, male, female)
de[, n_targets := lengths(reg_list)[regulon]]
de[, direction := fifelse(FDR >= 0.05, "ns",
                   fifelse(median_difference > 0, "up in MBC", "down in MBC"))]
de[, .N, by = direction]
de[FDR < 0.05][order(median_difference)][1:20]
fwrite(de, file.path(out_dir, "regulon_differential_MBC_vs_FBC_genie3.csv"))
```

## 4. Volcano

```{r volcano, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=5.5}
lab <- rbind(de[direction == "up in MBC"][order(FDR)][1:10],
             de[direction == "down in MBC"][order(FDR)][1:10])[!is.na(regulon)]
p_vol <- ggplot(de, aes(median_difference, -log10(FDR), color = direction)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_targets), alpha = .7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("up in MBC" = "red", "down in MBC" = "blue", ns = "grey75"),
                     breaks = c("up in MBC", "down in MBC", "ns")) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 5), name = "targets") +
  geom_text_repel(data = lab, aes(label = regulon), size = 3, show.legend = FALSE,
                  max.overlaps = 30) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
  labs(x = "Median AUCell difference (MBC - FBC)", y = "-log10 FDR (Wilcoxon, BH)",
       color = NULL, title = "Regulon activity, Callari cohort (GENIE3)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = .6),
        panel.grid = element_blank())
p_vol
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "regulon_volcano_genie3.pdf"), p_vol, width = 6.5, height = 5.5)
```
